{{Short description|Medieval English mathematician}}
{{Use dmy dates|date=April 2022}}
'''Gerland''' was an 11th-century mathematician who flourished in [[England]] following the [[Norman conquest of England|Norman Conquest]]. Little is known of his personal life. His treatise on the [[Computus]] may be found in the [[British Museum]] and his work on the [[abacus]] is preserved in the [[Bibliothèque nationale de France]] in [[Paris]].<ref>{{cite book|title=Biographia Britannica Literaria: Or, Biography of Literary Characters of Great Britain and Ireland|last=Wright|first=Thomas|date=1846|publisher=J.W. Parker|pages=16–18}}
</ref>
